figures.finding: The Uganda Communications Commission's Content Development Support Programme, in its third edition, awarded about UGX 1.38 billion in September 2026 to 22 competitively selected projects in five categories, up to UGX 80 million for a feature, about UGX 143-150 million for a TV drama series and UGX 20-25 million for a short; 299 local films were entered for the 2025/26 Uganda Film Festival.
